lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you called for him. Fastest next step: call 5 4 1, 4 5 1, 1 2 7 1 now. That’s the overnight warming shelter at 3000 South Santiam Highway, Lebanon. Tell them: “I’m calling for my cousin, he was put out today and needs a bed tonight.” They don’t require documents. If he’s in immediate danger right now, call 9 1 1 first.
